items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: my band was playing with Ike there and backing him

ctx.x: friends over a period of years, even when he became ill. He was out in Iowa somewhere here, oh, a year and a half ago, and he was connected in some other profession, and I used to get letters from him. He'd always send me little quotes and things, you know.

So here a few months ago, right here in Denver, Colorado, I was playing out, I think, a job -- I think it was out to a town near Villa, and Ike Cole was appearing here for a week. That's Nat's brother, of course. And Tiny heard that my band was playing with Ike there and backing him, and he must have gotten the time wrong because it was a week engagement, and he told me this on the phone -- he went out to hear me, and when he called me up, I almost cried because he had lost his voice, you know. He was real ill…
And I talked to the guy like today, and a week later I was supposed to see him, and I read an article in the paper where Tiny Hill had passed. And that hurt me no end, you know.
